props.subtitle: Process
props.title: How we work together
props.text: Common questions about collaboration, timelines, and what to expect when working with Marcus.

items.title: What types of projects do you take on?
items.text: Narrative films, documentaries, commercials, music videos, and branded content. If it involves a camera and a story, let's talk.

items.title: What does your process look like?
items.text: It starts with a conversation about your vision. From there we move into pre-production planning, production, and post — I'm involved at every stage to ensure a cohesive result.

items.title: How far in advance should I book?
items.text: Ideally 4–8 weeks for larger productions. Smaller projects can sometimes come together faster depending on availability.

items.title: Do you work with brands and agencies?
items.text: Yes. I regularly collaborate with creative agencies and brands on campaign films, product launches, and social content.

props.title: Let's bring your story to life
props.text: Currently booking projects for 2026. Reach out to discuss your next film, commercial, or campaign.
